# LJ Fashion

> Designed Beyond the Trend

A women's wear fashion brand founded by Linda Joweigha, specializing in timeless, versatile, and effortlessly elegant pieces designed for the modern woman's everyday life.

Core Identity

- Full Name: LJ Fashion
- Location: Lagos, Nigeria
- Mission: To end the daily compromise between comfort and style by creating versatile, high-quality wardrobe pieces designed beyond fleeting trends.
- Brand Aesthetic: Cream, ink, and taupe palette with editorial typography (Cormorant Garamond + Jost + Alex Brush).
- Founder: Linda Joweigha, Creative Director.

Primary Collections & Categories

- Dresses: Maxi dresses, kaftans, and flowing silhouettes for everyday elegance.
- Modest Wear: Powder blue kaftans, abayas, and coordinated sets offering full coverage without sacrificing contemporary taste.
- Occasion Wear: Dressy pieces including eyelet lace dresses with rhinestone detailing for special occasions.
- Bottoms: Wide-leg trousers and palazzo pants in solid burgundy, white, and patterned designs.

Bestseller Products

- The Layered Asymmetrical Top (NGN 42,000): A sleeveless structured black top with an angular extended hemline layered over a blue-and-white striped shirt with built-in pleated shorts.
- The Black Shirt Dress (NGN 38,500): A flowing button-up shirt dress paired with matching wide-leg trousers in a monochromatic ensemble.
- The Pink Striped Kaftan (NGN 36,000): A flowing kaftan-style maxi dress in soft pink-coral with a vertical multi-colour stripe panel and side slits.

Brand Philosophy

- Design Ethos: "Where soft meets statement" — clothing that complements who you are, not overwhelms it.
- Quality Pillars: Quality, Comfort, Timeless Design.
- Production: Each piece is made to order in the Lagos atelier with a focus on clean seaming and fabric integrity.
- Lead Time: 7–10 business days for production and shipping within Nigeria.

Target Audience

- Modern women seeking versatile, timeless wardrobes
- Professionals balancing work and family life
- Women who value modest aesthetics with contemporary design
- Customers in Nigeria and the African diaspora

Technical Notes

- Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS 4
- All fonts self-hosted (no third-party CDN dependencies)
- Images served in AVIF/WebP format with lazy loading
- Content-Security-Policy: strict, same-origin only (no external assets loaded client-side)
- Image download protection enabled (right-click and drag disabled on images)
- All product images watermarked with the LJ logo

This file enables AI applications and agents to easily access and understand the LJ Fashion website context.
